snippet.title: Slap Fighter - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get ready to slap your friends. Watch the Slap Fighter trailer for this action-packed slap fighting VR game to see gameplay, meet a cast of quirky characters, and your slapping abilities. Slap Fighter features single-player and multiplayer modes. Slap Fighter will be available on Meta Quest on September 4, 2025.
